 A Navien™ combi-boiler is a high efficiency boiler and tankless water heater all-in-one appliance that can provide whole house heating for small to large homes, and endless hot water for up to 3 showers and a dishwasher at the same time. 

 Features 
 
 Smart controls LCD display, quick dial wheel & Setup Wizard 
 Advanced stainless steel dual heat exchangers 
 15:1 DHW and up to 10:1 heating TDR 
 Field convertible gas system (NG/LP) up to 10,100 ft. 
 Capable of cascading up to 15 NPE water heaters 
 Capable of common venting up to 7 NPE water heaters 
 Built-in 3 zone pumps and 3 zone valves powered connections 
 2” PVC venting up to 65′ and 3” venting up to 150′ 
 
 Warranty 
 Navien’s ™ NCB-H line of products come with a limited warranty of 1 year for labor, 5 years for parts, and 10 years for the heat exchanger.

title: Navien™ NPE-150S2 120,000 BTU Condensing High-Efficiency Gas Tankless Water Heater
source_facts:
Navien™ has been pushing the boundaries of efficiency for 25 years. The NPE-150S2 utilizes condensing technology which captures additional heat lost by typical water heaters. Its energy factor is superior to traditional water heaters and non-condensing tankless models. Reduced vent temperatures due to this condensing technology allow you to use PVC venting, which saves you money and improves the ease of installation. The Navien™ tankless water heater has excellent technology for reducing your heating costs and carbon footprint. 

 Features 
 
 ½” gas pipe capable of up to 24 feet 
 Field convertible gas system 
 Ultra condensing efficiency 
 Dual stainless steel heat exchangers 
 Low NOx emissions (20ppm) 
 SCH 40, 2″ venting up to 75 feet 
 Cascading capable of up to 32 units 
 EZNav multi-line control panel 
 Built-in HotButton control panel 
 Common vent up to 12 units 
 
 Includes:
 
 
 (1) Wall Mounting Bracket 
 (4) Tapping Screw & Anchor 
 (2) Vent Terminator 
 (4) Wall Flange 
 
 Warranty 
 Residential: 1-year labor, 3-year parts, and 5-year heat exchanger
 Commercial: 1-year labor, 3-year parts, and 3-year heat exchanger

The  BendPak LR-60P  is a  portable, low-rise lift  designed for  maximum versatility in professional shops and home garages . With a  6,000 lb. lifting capacity , this lift features  high-density UHMW rollers , allowing for  easy relocation between service bays . 
 Its  compact and low-profile design  collapses to just  4 inches , making it ideal for  low-clearance vehicles  while ensuring  easy storage and maneuverability . Equipped with an  electric/hydraulic power system, multi-position safety locks, and a single-point safety release , the  LR-60P delivers convenience, efficiency, and safety in one durable package . 

 
 Key Features & Benefits 
 
 6,000 lb. Lifting Capacity  – Ideal for  cars, SUVs, and light-duty trucks . 
 Portable Design with High-Density UHMW Rollers  – 
 
 Easily move the lift between bays  with minimal effort. 
 Extremely durable rollers  that won’t wear out or need replacing. 
 
 
 Tow Handle Included  – Allows  one-person mobility and positioning . 
 Low-Profile Height (4″)  – Suitable for  low-stance vehicles  with minimal ground clearance.

 Single-Point Safety Release  – Allows  both locks to release simultaneously  for a controlled descent.

title: Ooni Koda 2
source_facts:
The Ooni Koda 2 is a second-generation gas pizza oven built for fast, consistent results in a compact, portable size. Choose Foundry Black or Slate Blue and cook up to 14″ pizzas, with the oven reaching up to 500°C and delivering Neapolitan-style bakes in as little as 60 seconds. 

 At the heart of Koda 2 is G2 Gas Technology, using a patent-pending tapered flame burner to improve heat distribution and give you finer control, helping reduce hot and cold spots across the stone. It’s also designed for back-to-back cooking, with a 50% thicker stone for better heat retention and 20% faster reheat time than the previous Koda 12. 

 Koda 2 stays genuinely easy to move and store at 16kg, and Ooni notes it’s optimised for propane, supplied with a gas hose and regulator for clip-on style patio gas canisters.

title: Ooni Koda 2 Pro
source_facts:
The Ooni Koda 2 Pro is a second-generation gas pizza oven built for faster heat-up, steadier temperatures, and more space to cook. With an 18″+ cooking area and a stone that’s 21″ at the front and 18″ at the rear, you’ve got plenty of room for bigger pizzas, pans, and cast-iron cooks. 

 It uses G2 Gas Technology with a tapered flame burner designed to reduce hot and cold spots and reheat the stone quicker, making back-to-back cooks easier. It also includes the Ooni Connect Digital Temperature Hub so you can track temperatures more confidently while you cook. 

 Expect proper high-heat performance too, reaching up to 500°C and cooking pizzas in as little as 60 seconds. Available in Foundry Black and Slate Blue.

source_facts:

Powered by a 212cc Predator engine, this generator delivers 3500 max starting watts and 3000 max running watts, making it ideal for RVs, camping, tailgating, and powering sensitive electronics. It uses pure sine wave inverter technology, ensuring clean power for electronics like smartphones, laptops, and TVs.

 With a 2.3-gallon fuel tank, the generator offers up to 11 hours of runtime at 25% load, making it perfect for long-lasting power needs without constant refueling. Its SUPER QUIET™ enclosure keeps noise levels at a mere 56 dBA, which is comparable to the sound of a quiet conversation.

 This inverter generator is also built with CO SECURE™ technology, which automatically shuts the unit down if dangerous carbon monoxide levels are detected, keeping you and your surroundings safe. It’s compact and lightweight, with smooth-rolling wheels for easy portability, and comes with an RV adapter for hassle-free use.
